discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 6e230c77e. Extracted the archive handler's leave-route logic into a shared `leaveRouteIfCurrent` helper in `App.tsx` and call it from `handleSessionDeleted` too, so deleting the currently-open chat navigates to `/` instead of leaving a stale `resumeSessionId` that PairRouteWrapper/ChatSessionsContainer would re-render.

Fixed in e0bd6c55f. `handleToggleArchive` now updates the row in place when the current filter is `all` (the Active-tab-with-search case, where a restored/archived session still matches), and only drops it in the scoped `active`/`archived` views where the toggle actually moves it out of the filter.
